context: Two teens debrief about a friend group on the way home
purpose: Teach: いまや/おくれ/暖かく/例年/短時間/知り合っ/昼寝/甘え

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日のミナちゃん、ちょっと甘えてる感じだったよね。
lines.en: Mina seemed kinda clingy today, didn't she?
lines.style: casual teen girl voice, slightly gossipy tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる。普段クールなのに、いまや別人みたいだし。
lines.en: Right? She's usually the cool one, but now she's like a totally different person.
lines.style: teen boy, amused observational tone with a chuckle

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ハルキと知り合ってから変わったよね、こないだの放課後さ。
lines.en: She changed after meeting Haruki, you know, that thing after school the other day.
lines.style: teasing teen girl, conspiratorial whisper between friends

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あー、おくれて教室入ってきた日ね。あんな短時間で何があったんだか。
lines.en: Ah, the day he came into the classroom late. Wonder what happened in that short window.
lines.style: teen boy, half-laughing curiosity in his voice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日とか急に暖かくなったし、みんなテンション高めだった。
lines.en: It got suddenly warm today too, so everyone was kinda hyped.
lines.style: casual teen girl, breezy stroll-home pace and rhythm

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ユウタなんて授業中ずっと昼寝してたぞ。当てられて慌ててたし。
lines.en: Yuta was straight-up napping the whole class. Got called on and totally panicked.
lines.style: teen boy, laughing recollection of the moment

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 例年このクラス、五月病で皆ダラダラしてるって先輩言ってたよ。
lines.en: The seniors said every year this class gets all sluggish from May blues.
lines.style: teen girl, casual gossip-relay tone walking home

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うちらも人のこと言えないけどね。じゃ、また明日、駅前で。
lines.en: Not like we can talk, though. Alright, see you tomorrow in front of the station.
lines.style: teen boy, friendly sign-off wave at the corner
